coverLetter: I came across the Backend Software Engineer opening at Catawiki and knew I had to reach out. The scale you're operating at—75,000 auctions weekly, millions of visitors—is exactly the kind of challenge I thrive on.

What drew me in wasn't just the technical challenge, though. Your values of ownership and growth mindset genuinely resonate with me. I've seen how teams move faster and build better when everyone takes initiative and keeps learning.

Over the past seven years, I've built backend systems for e-commerce and SaaS platforms, focusing on reliable APIs, database performance, and keeping services running smoothly under load. My resume covers the specifics—PHP, Laravel, PostgreSQL, the usual suspects—but what matters most is that I enjoy solving hard problems and shipping code that holds up in production.
I'd love to chat about how I could contribute to Catawiki's mission. I'm available for an interview at your convenience.
